headline: Give your agent tools the night off.
voice: Why keep a tool running all night for one morning report? With SlimFaas, idle agent tools can sleep.

headline: Ready when you call.
voice: Keep your existing HTTP app. The next call wakes a worker and waits for the answer. Here, one sleeping tool comes back with fifty-five.

headline: Take the morning rush in stride.
voice: Then the rush hits. We sent thirty calculations at once. The queue held the work while four workers shared the load.

headline: All done. Clock out.
voice: All thirty finished. The workers went back to zero, freeing capacity for the next thing your team wants to run.

headline: Give one tool a five-minute try.
voice: Pick a tool your agent already calls. Run the local demo and watch it wake up. Then let it sleep.
